study: Duncan et al. 2018, Math for All (EDC, IES R305A140488)
delivery_evidence: MFA = five one-day workshops + classroom-based assignments (50 hrs over a school year): lesson study, collaborative planning, peer coaching, video-case analysis (p.~ MFA description, intro). Face-to-face PD.
test_alignment_evidence: Outcome = NWEA Measures of Academic Progress (MAP) math, a broad independent standardized adaptive assessment not tailored to MFA (Exhibit 10; Exhibit 20, printed p.37).
curriculum_evidence: 'MFA is not focused on the delivery of a specific curriculum'; teachers apply the PD to 'the particular standards-based curriculum they are using in their school' (MFA description). No new curriculum provided.
outcome_timing_evidence: Extracted effect = Spring 2016 MAP, end of Year 1 (the implementation year); Year 2 results excluded for attrition (design; Exhibit 20).
